extDescription.message: Record Google Meet, turn live captions into a transcript, and summarize it with AI.

meetTabNone.message: Open a Google Meet call in this tab

meetReload.message: Reload this Meet tab once so AfterCall can read captions

ccOn.message: On. Check the caption language matches the meeting

ccOff.message: Off. Press c in Meet, or there will be no transcript

selfNameMissing.message: Not set. You will appear as "You" in the transcript

micOn.message: Your voice is mixed into the recording

micOff.message: Off. Only the call audio is recorded

chatOn.message: People in the call see that you are recording

chatOff.message: Off. People will not know they are being recorded

ccOffWarn.message: Captions are off, so nothing is being transcribed. Press c in Meet.

micFailedWarn.message: The microphone was not allowed, so your voice is not in this recording.

summaryEmpty.message: No transcript to summarize: captions were off

fail_auth.message: Summary failed: $1 is not logged in

fail_retry.message: Summary failed: the AI call did not go through. Try again

fail_format.message: Summary failed: the model answered in the wrong format. Try again

chatLabel.message: Announce in Meet chat when recording starts

chatConfirm.message: Turn off the announcement? People in the call will not know they are being recorded, which may break privacy law (PDPA) or company policy.

err_notmeet.message: This tab is not a Google Meet call

micPageBody.message: AfterCall mixes your voice into the recording. Click the button and choose Allow.

micPageOk.message: Done. You can close this tab.

micPageFailed.message: Not allowed. Allow the microphone for AfterCall in Chrome settings, then try again.

err_invoke.message: Click the AfterCall icon in the toolbar while on this Meet tab, then press Start again

deleteConfirm.message: Delete this recording's video, transcript and summary from your computer? This cannot be undone.

shortcutMark.message: Press $1 to mark without opening this panel

capUnreadable.message: Captions are on screen but AfterCall cannot read them, so the transcript is empty. The video is still recording. Reload the Meet tab, or report it on GitHub.

capQuiet.message: No captions for 2 minutes. If people are talking, press c twice in Meet to restart captions.

aiNoHost.message: Not connected. Only needed when you summarize

aiNoCli.message: Connected, but $1 is not installed on this computer

fail_nohost.message: Summary failed: AI is not connected on this computer. See Settings

fail_nocli.message: Summary failed: $1 is not installed on this computer

fail_limit.message: Summary failed: your $1 usage limit is reached. Try again later

providerNote.message: Uses the subscription you are logged in to on this computer. No API key needed

effortHint.message: How hard the model thinks. Higher is more thorough but slower and uses more quota

modelHint.message: Models from $1 on this computer. Bigger models summarize better but use more quota

step1.message: Install $1 and log in, in a terminal

step2.message: In a terminal, go to the aftercall folder and run

use1.message: In a Meet call, turn on CC and press Start

use2.message: Press Stop when the meeting ends. The video and transcript are saved

use3.message: Press "Summarize with AI" on the latest recording. $1 writes summary.md and uses your account quota

fail_model.message: Summary failed: $1 cannot use this model. Check the model name in Settings

talkTitle.message: Who talked how much (by amount of text)

catchUpRunning.message: Summarizing what was said so far… Recording continues

notesHint.message: Sent with every summary to say what to focus on, or to ask for an extra section. The 6 main sections stay

notesPlaceholder.message: e.g. This is a daily standup. Focus on blockers and who needs help
